text: The customer wants a refund for a duplicate charge of ₹1,299 on card ending in 4417 from 12 Nov. The agent confirmed the duplicate charge and initiated a reversal with the payment partner under reference RV-220918. Next, the bank is expected to credit the funds within 3–5 working days, and the customer plans to file a bank dispute if the refund is not received by 20 Nov.
